Israel formally recognizes WWI Armenian genocide, straining Turkey ties

Israel's government has unanimously approved a decision to formally recognize the violence against Armenians during World War I as a genocide. This move, which historians estimate led to the deaths of up to 1.5 million Armenians, has sparked debate over political motives and is expected to deepen a rift with Turkey, a key ally of Azerbaijan.
